title: MiniHackers
tagline: Mini hackers would like to organize kid friendly areas with a playground, arcade, and arts and crafts. We want to create workshops to educate young kids on the world of web3.

prizes.placement: 🤑 Polygon — Best Local LATAM Public Goods or Refi Project
prizes.title: Polygon

description:
We would love to create a more family friendly event that not only helps entertain kids but also educates and onboards them into web3. Our core four goals would be to make kid friendly areas, have families travel together, educate through workshops and provide scholarships to local youth.

The kid zone would consist of three main objectives play, build and create. Having a designated area for kids, families, adults to let off some steam. This would include play structures for younger kids, interactive game like bubble hockey and yes maybe even gaming.building and creating would come through hands on activities such as legos and crafting.

We want families to be able to travel the world exploring in the many cultures while hacking together. We would want families to know that there is something here for everyone, including education through workshops, getting kids of all ages involved with hands on demonstrations, and the ability to ask questions and collaborate with their peers. This is a place we believe we can have a huge impact on the future generation of hackers and innovators. Getting young kids onboarded with skills that lead to careers.

We believe through scholarships and bounties we could help open doors for a wider variety of people, especially children and their parents. By working with local schools and organizations we can create bounties for students to earn a scholarship to attend ETHglobal event and participate in workshops and possibly even hack.this along with ETHglobal event bounties could have an a great impact on a young person.
